digest.component_or_area: store write path (event_append.py, staging, ticket creation)
propositions: Ticket directory creation currently races between os.makedirs and the first event file write, leaving empty orphaned directories visible to fsck when interrupted.
Solution stages directory and CREATE event together atomically using a pid/uuid-suffixed temp path, then renames under the write lock so both appear or neither does.
Temp paths named .tmp-newticket-* are invisible to fsck scanners by existing convention (dot-prefix exclusion) without requiring scanner changes.
All mkdir-then-first-file sites in the store write path must be converted (batch_stage_and_commit, inbound_translate._write_event_file, dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT) or explicitly exempted.
Stale staging directories from dead processes are swept at writer startup using process-start-time stamp to defeat pid recycling, removing only writer's own staging area never ticket data.
